why: jkrumm's CSS has 62 raw-px sites, 36 hex and 13 viewport queries against its own written law; a preset makes the law an error on .css, .astro style blocks and .mdx.
what: New: packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/stylelint/** (preset, config renderer, tests), configs/stylelint*, test/fixtures/lint/stylelint/**.
must_not_touch: package.json and bun.lock (v3-deps-w2 / v3-deps-ai added your pins)
contract: docs/v3/concepts/static-framework-free.md section 4.2 (rule table), 8 (P6, P7, F-S1); docs/v3/concepts/guardrails.md sections 5 and 6.
exemplar: packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-oxlint.ts and configs/oxlint-plugin.test.ts (2.x generated preset, seeded fixtures per rule).
change: Pins: stylelint 18.0.0 and postcss-html, added by v3-deps-w2; v3-sk-3's init writes them into a consumer. Preset: one generated config exported as basalt-ui/stylelint (the exports entry rel-7 allocated): exactly the ten core rules of static-framework-free 4.2 plus colour-as-decoration (status, brand, chart, seq roles and -tint barred from background*, border*, outline*, box-shadow; text, fill, stroke legal), the three report-*-disables options and postcss-html for .astro/.mdx style blocks. renderStylelintConfig({ ignoreFiles }) in src/lint/stylelint/render.ts returns the text of .stylelintrc.basalt.json; v3-sk-3 feeds it the manifest's tokens[].out paths (a field v3-sk-2 adds) through the presetFiles seam, so this row only reads the manifest type. Waiver form: stylelint-disable-next-line rule -- reason. Inline style= is check-tokens' job. Test: a seeded offender per bypass plus clean fixtures.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Stylelint Node API with the SHIPPED config; run it read-only over ~/SourceRoot/jkrumm.com/src and put per-rule counts in the PR (F-S1: over 15 percent legitimate means per-glob exemptions, never rule removal).
acceptance: Each seeded offender fires its rule: named colour, rgb(), oklch(), color-mix(in srgb, red ...), light-dark(), rem and calc() padding, raw border-radius, a --vx-brand declaration, a coloured border-left, background var(--vx-good-tint), !important, a viewport @media, [data-slot]
Clean fixtures yield 0 warnings: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vx-good) 10%, transparent), color: var(--vx-brand), fill: var(--vx-chart-1)
A <style> block in an .astro fixture is linted; a scan of 0 files fails
renderStylelintConfig with tokens[].out = src/styles/tokens.css lists it in ignoreFiles, and a hex inside that file is then not reported
out_of_scope: doctor wiring (v3-sk-3a), the lint verb (v3-sk-4), oxlint rules, check-tokens, any consumer file.
test_layout: Fixtures live in packages/basalt-ui/test/fixtures/**, hidden from root lint, fmt and bun test by v3-test-roots; runners in tests/** or src/**. Add no ignore lines.
